author: D00ZiE
body:
Reported Player(s): ChampionCreeper
Rules Broken: Excessive infractions after a tempban for excessive infractions.
Evidence: http://avicus.net/user/ChampionCreeper?page=1&tab=infractions
You'll see that this player has 10 infractions after being temp banned for having an excessive amount of infractions. This seems a little ridiculous to me and I feel as though this player requires a harsher punishment.
